finally made my blogging page! yay!

i'm not dead set on this layout and i dont exactly know what i'll post about here yet. but its up and thats what matters! i can make it better later


today, i'll use it as a diary (kind of).

i went to the movies to watch Coyote vs. Acme and i'm so glad i did! i absolutely LOVED it. other than Obsession that was pretty much the only movie i really like this year (havent watched the spider-man one yet!)

that was sooo nostalgic, you might think looney tunes was too old for my generation, but i'm brazilian and those cartoons stood there for much longer. i grew up watching them!


not only that, this movie awakened the ''fandom spirit'' in me. i'll write more about it on my next post. for this one, let me just mention i'm genuinely obsessed with wilerunner edits... i learnt so much shipping facts about them and find them so cute... its such a weird couple to ship but TRUST ME if you give it a chance you'll be taken away too.


i know people here dont love social media — i swear im trying to get away from it — but search it on tiktok and fall in love.


also, that was FINALLY a movie with actual substance. they criticize corporations so directly, i missed this type of kids content so badly. everything has been so apolitical, this movie was a breath of fresh air.

its rare for this type of live action to be well executed, even rarer to have a good plot (cant even mention another example tbh) so this is definetely a must watch! will add it to my logs tomorrow :)
